_doc: Phase 90.L DEV diagnostic set (NOT a validation set, never reserved): can the write side tell apart a durable state assertion, a correction, a bare current activity, a proposal, an intention, a negation, a third party, a question and a decision to change focus? Authored 2026-09-08 BEFORE running anything. The target slot is `project.main` throughout, so the only thing that varies is the modality of the sentence, not the vocabulary of the slot. `expect_canon` is what the fact ledger must hold for project.main after the message (null = no write); `why` states the rule, never a phrase. PT and EN paraphrases of each class.

rule.write: a durable state assertion about the USER, evidenced either by the slot's own noun ('project'/'projecto') or by a change-of-state marker the store already recognises (actually / na verdade; used to be ... now; since <year>)
rule.do_not_write: proposals (should/devíamos), intentions (want to/going to/quero/vou), bare current activity with no scope or change marker, negations (no new value), third-party sentences, questions
rule.ambiguous: bare activity ('we are working on X') — an activity now is not evidence that it is the user's MAIN project; the honest outcome is no canon write and an episode only

cases.text: My main project is Mapiko.
cases.why: the slot's own noun, present tense, first person

cases.text: O meu projecto principal é o Mapiko.
cases.why: the slot's own noun in PT

cases.text: The project I work on is Mapiko.
cases.why: the slot's own noun as the subject

cases.text: Actually my main project is Mapiko, not Kuvala.
Na verdade estamos a trabalhar no HMG, este sistema de memória.
cases.why: correction marker (na verdade) on an activity clause = a stated change of what we work on

cases.text: we are actually working on HMG, this memory system of yours
cases.why: correction marker (actually) on an activity clause

cases.text: We are working on HMG.
cases.why: an activity now is not evidence that it is the MAIN project — episode only

cases.text: Estamos a trabalhar no HMG.
Today I am working on the parser.
cases.why: a day's activity is not a durable fact

cases.text: We should work on HMG.
cases.why: deontic — a proposal is not a fact

cases.text: Devíamos trabalhar no HMG.
Maybe we could work on HMG instead.
I want to work on HMG now.
Quero trabalhar no HMG agora.
I'm going to work on HMG tomorrow.
Vou trabalhar no HMG amanhã.
I plan to work on HMG.
cases.why: a plan is not a state

cases.text: We are not working on HMG any more.
cases.why: a negation adds no value; retraction only through the existing retraction contract

cases.text: Já não trabalhamos no HMG.
We never worked on HMG.
My colleague is working on HMG.
O meu colega está a trabalhar no HMG.
My brother's main project is HMG.
cases.why: the slot's noun, but the possessor is not the user

cases.text: Are we working on HMG?
Estamos a trabalhar no HMG?
From now on my project is HMG.
cases.why: explicit change of state + the slot's noun

cases.text: A partir de agora o meu projecto é o HMG.
My project used to be Kuvala but now it is HMG.
cases.why: the transition marker the store already recognises

cases.text: If we worked on HMG we would need more time.
In the story I'm writing, the team's main project is HMG.
O meu chefe disse: o nosso projecto principal é o HMG.
In 2019 my main project was Kuvala.
cases.why: dated past — history, not the current value
